entries.1dfb8dee72980ce3: This is the core business of the group, which consists of the Company and 12 consolidated subsidiaries (as of March 31, 2026), and its main activity is the manufacture and sale of custom-made wigs. The reportable segments are three, which divide hair-related products and services for general customers by customer gender: the "Men's Business," the "Women's Business" and the "Women's Ready-Made Products Business." For custom-made wigs, after the shape of the head is measured at a store with a 3D molding system, manufacturing is outsourced to a manufacturing subsidiary, and the Company purchases the finished products and delivers them through 283 stores in Japan.
